reason: I'd probably do the free week, then go back to the free postpartum core videos on YouTube like I always do. Twenty bucks isn't much, but I'm on parental leave pay and I've never paid for a workout program.
objection: There are heaps of free pelvic floor and tummy gap videos already, so I'm not sure this is different enough to pay for, and I doubt I'd even manage four sessions a week with a newborn.
would_change_my_mind: If a couple of mums from my mums' group did it and said it actually helped their tummy gap, or my physio recommended it, I'd pay the $19.99.
